Least Count of Vernier = 1 MSD - 1 VSD
Least Count of Screw Gauge = Pitch / Total Head Scale Divisions
formulaHints: [Force] = [MLT⁻²], [Energy] = [ML²T⁻²], [h] = [ML²T⁻¹]

topics.name: Uniform Circular Motion (Kinematics)
topics.nameHi: एकसमान वृत्तीय गति

keyConcepts: Equations of motion v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at², v² = u² + 2as are ONLY valid for constant acceleration.
Time of flight T = 2u sinθ / g; Maximum Height H = u² sin²θ / 2g; Range R = u² sin 2θ / g
Complementary angles θ and (90° - θ) have the exact same horizontal range for the same speed.
formulaHints: s_nth = u + a/2 (2n - 1)
R = 4H cotθ
Centripetal acceleration a_c = v² / r = ω² r
commonMistakes: Using equations of motion when acceleration is variable (e.g. a = 3t). Must use calculus: v = ∫a dt, s = ∫v dt.
Confusing speed with velocity in average velocity calculations.
shortTricks: Ratio of distances in consecutive seconds starting from rest with uniform acceleration is Galileo's odd numbers ratio 1 : 3 : 5 : 7...
For projectile launched horizontally from height h: t = √(2h/g), Range = u√(2h/g).

topics.name: Dynamics of Circular Motion & Banking of Roads
topics.nameHi: वृत्तीय गति की गतिकी और सड़कों की बंकन

keyConcepts: F_net = dp/dt = m(dv/dt) for constant mass.
Static friction is self-adjusting: 0 ≤ f_s ≤ μ_s N. Kinetic friction f_k = μ_k N.
Optimum speed on banked road v_opt = √(rg tanθ); Maximum safe speed v_max = √[rg (tanθ + μ) / (1 - μ tanθ)].
formulaHints: Impulse J = ∫ F dt = Δp = m(v - u)
Atwood Machine: a = (m₂ - m₁)g / (m₁ + m₂), Tension T = 2m₁m₂g / (m₁ + m₂)
Apparent weight in lift accelerating up: N = m(g + a); accelerating down: N = m(g - a)
commonMistakes: Assuming normal reaction is always mg. On an inclined plane N = mg cosθ; in an elevator N depends on acceleration.
Applying friction in direction opposite to motion instead of opposite to relative tendency of slipping.
shortTricks: Acceleration of block on rough incline sliding down: a = g(sinθ - μ cosθ).
If a body takes n times more time to slide down a rough incline of angle θ than a smooth incline of same angle: μ = tanθ(1 - 1/n²).

keyConcepts: Work-Energy Theorem: W_all forces = ΔK = K_f - K_i
Conservative force F = -dU/dx; for equilibrium dU/dx = 0 (stable if d²U/dx² > 0)
Vertical circle minimum velocity at lowest point for full looping v_L = √(5gl), at highest point v_T = √(gl)
formulaHints: W = ∫ F · dr = Area under F-x curve
Spring Potential Energy U = 0.5 k x²
Power P = F · v = dW/dt
Coefficient of restitution e = (v₂ - v₁) / (u₁ - u₂)
commonMistakes: Thinking normal force never does work. Normal force can do work if the surface in contact is moving (e.g. lift).
Forgetting tension at top of vertical circle must be ≥ 0 for complete loop, not velocity ≥ 0.
shortTricks: Fractional loss of kinetic energy in direct inelastic collision when one body was at rest: ΔK/K = m₂ / (m₁ + m₂).
After n bounces from height h with coefficient of restitution e: Height h_n = e^(2n) · h.

topics.name: Rolling Motion on Horizontal and Inclined Planes
topics.nameHi: लोटनिक गति (आनत तल पर)

keyConcepts: τ = r × F = Iα = dL/dt. If external torque is zero, angular momentum L = Iω is conserved.
Parallel axis theorem: I = I_cm + Md²; Perpendicular axis theorem (laminar body only): I_z = I_x + I_y.
Rolling without slipping: v_cm = Rω, K_total = 0.5 m v_cm² (1 + k²/R²).
formulaHints: Solid Sphere: I = (2/5)MR²; Hollow Sphere: I = (2/3)MR²
Disc / Solid Cylinder: I = (1/2)MR²; Ring / Hollow Cylinder: I = MR²
Rod (center): I = ML²/12; Rod (end): I = ML²/3
Acceleration down incline: a = g sinθ / (1 + k²/R²)
commonMistakes: Applying perpendicular axis theorem to 3D bodies like spheres or cylinders (only valid for 2D planar laminas).
Confusing center of mass with center of gravity in non-uniform gravitational fields.
shortTricks: In rolling down incline race: body with SMALLEST (k²/R²) reaches bottom first with maximum speed: Solid Sphere (0.4) > Disc (0.5) > Hollow Sphere (0.67) > Ring (1.0).

topics.name: Escape Velocity & Orbital Velocity of Satellites, Geostationary Satellites
topics.nameHi: पलायन वेग एवं उपग्रह का कक्षीय वेग

keyConcepts: Kepler's 2nd Law (Law of Areas) is a direct consequence of Conservation of Angular Momentum (dA/dt = L / 2m = constant).
Kepler's 3rd Law: T² ∝ r³.
Escape velocity v_e = √(2GM/R) = √(2gR) ≈ 11.2 km/s on Earth.
Orbital velocity v_o = √(GM/r) = v_e / √2 (for surface orbit).
formulaHints: At height h << R: g' = g(1 - 2h/R); At any h: g' = g [R / (R+h)]²
At depth d: g' = g(1 - d/R)
With latitude λ: g' = g - Rω² cos²λ (g maximum at poles, minimum at equator)
Total energy of orbiting satellite E = -GMm / (2r) = -K = U/2
commonMistakes: Using g' = g(1 - 2h/R) when h is large (e.g. h = R). Always use exact formula g' = g [R / (R+h)]².
Forgetting the negative sign in gravitational potential U = -GMm/r.
shortTricks: Binding energy of satellite is equal in magnitude to its Kinetic Energy: BE = +GMm / (2r).
Ratio of escape velocity to orbital velocity for near-earth orbit is always √2 : 1.

keyConcepts: Terminal velocity v_t = 2r²(ρ - σ)g / (9η) → v_t ∝ r².
Bernoulli's Equation: P + 0.5 ρ v² + ρ g h = Constant.
Excess pressure in liquid drop = 2T/R; soap bubble (two surfaces) = 4T/R.
Capillary rise: h = 2T cosθ / (r ρ g).
formulaHints: Elastic potential energy density = 0.5 × Stress × Strain = 0.5 × Y × (Strain)²
Equation of continuity: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂
Speed of efflux: v = √(2gh) (Torricelli's Law)
commonMistakes: Using 2T/R for soap bubbles instead of 4T/R (soap bubble has inner and outer free liquid-air interfaces).
Confusing steel and rubber elasticity: Steel is MORE elastic than rubber because it requires greater stress for same strain.
shortTricks: When n small droplets of radius r coalesce to form one big drop of radius R: R = n^(1/3) r, Energy released = 4πT R² [n^(1/3) - 1].
Angle of contact θ < 90° for wetting liquids (water on glass); θ > 90° for non-wetting (mercury on glass).

topics.nameHi: कार्नो इंजन, दक्षता एवं प्रशीतक

topics.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases: RMS Speed, Degrees of Freedom & Equipartition
topics.nameHi: गैसों का अणुगति सिद्धांत, वर्ग माध्य मूल चाल

keyConcepts: Work done in isobaric: W = PΔV; Isothermal: W = nRT ln(V₂/V₁); Adiabatic: W = (P₁V₁ - P₂V₂) / (γ - 1).
Efficiency of Carnot Engine η = 1 - T_C / T_H = (Q_H - Q_C) / Q_H (Temperatures MUST be in Kelvin!).
RMS speed v_rms = √(3RT/M) = √(3kT/m); Average speed = √(8RT/πM); Most Probable speed = √(2RT/M).
formulaHints: ΔU = n C_v ΔT = n (R / (γ - 1)) ΔT (always true for ideal gas regardless of path)
C_p - C_v = R; γ = C_p / C_v = 1 + 2/f (f = degrees of freedom)
Monoatomic (f=3, γ=5/3); Diatomic (f=5, γ=7/5); Polyatomic (f=6, γ=4/3)
commonMistakes: Inserting Celsius temperatures into Carnot efficiency formulas. Carnot calculations strictly require Kelvin!
Confusing physics sign convention (W = ∫ P dV, done BY gas) with chemistry sign convention (W = -P_ext ΔV, done ON gas).
shortTricks: Slope of adiabatic PV curve is γ times steeper than isothermal PV curve: (dP/dV)_adi = γ (dP/dV)_iso.
Ratio of speeds: v_rms : v_avg : v_mp = √3 : √(8/π) : √2 ≈ 1.73 : 1.60 : 1.41 (RAM rule: R > A > M).

topics.name: Beats Phenomenon
topics.nameHi: विस्पंद परिघटना

nmcNotes: Doppler Effect was removed in NMC revised syllabus, but standing waves in pipes and beats remain high-yield.
keyConcepts: SHM condition: a = -ω² x; Time period T = 2π/ω.
Total Energy in SHM: E = 0.5 m ω² A² = constant. At mean position K is max; at extreme U is max.
Open Organ Pipe: contains all harmonics (f, 2f, 3f...); fundamental f₁ = v / (2L).
Closed Organ Pipe: contains ONLY odd harmonics (f, 3f, 5f...); fundamental f₁ = v / (4L).
formulaHints: Simple Pendulum: T = 2π √(L/g)
Spring pendulum: T = 2π √(m/k); In series: 1/k_eq = 1/k₁ + 1/k₂; In parallel: k_eq = k₁ + k₂
Beat frequency = |f₁ - f₂|
commonMistakes: Thinking frequency of kinetic energy is same as SHM frequency. Kinetic and Potential energy oscillate at TWICE the SHM frequency (2f).
Forgetting end correction e = 0.6r in organ pipes if tube radius is given.
shortTricks: Cutting spring of constant k into n equal parts: each new spring has constant n·k.
Waxing a tuning fork decreases its frequency; filing increases its frequency.

topics.name: Capacitors: Parallel Plate, Dielectrics, Combinations & Energy Stored
topics.nameHi: संधारित्र: समांतर पट्ट, परावैद्युत, संयोजन एवं ऊर्जा

topics.name: Common Potential & Loss of Energy on Connecting Capacitors
topics.nameHi: उभयनिष्ठ विभव एवं ऊर्जा ह्रास

nmcNotes: Van de Graaff generator deleted in revised syllabus. Dielectric slabs and Gauss's law are primary focuses.
keyConcepts: Electric field is conservative: E = -dV/dr = -∇V.
Electric dipole moment p = q × 2a (directed from negative to positive). On axial line: E_axial = 2kp/r³; on equatorial line: E_equatorial = kp/r³.
Energy stored in capacitor: U = 0.5 CV² = Q² / (2C) = 0.5 QV.
When battery disconnected: Charge Q remains constant. When battery connected: Potential V remains constant.
formulaHints: Capacitance of parallel plate: C = ε₀ A / d; With dielectric slab of thickness t: C = ε₀ A / (d - t + t/K)
Energy density u_E = 0.5 ε₀ E²
Loss of energy: ΔU = 0.5 · [C₁C₂ / (C₁+C₂)] (V₁ - V₂)²
commonMistakes: Applying Gauss's law flux formula Φ = q_enclosed / ε₀ without checking whether charge is strictly enclosed within surface.
Confusing effect of dielectric: if battery is connected, V is constant and Q increases by K; if battery disconnected, Q is constant and V decreases by 1/K.
shortTricks: Inside a charged conducting sphere/shell: E = 0, but potential V = constant = kQ/R (same as at surface).
Field outside spherical shell at distance r ≥ R behaves as if entire charge is concentrated at the center.

topics.name: Kirchhoff's Laws (Junction & Loop Rule) and Wheatstone Bridge
topics.nameHi: किरचॉफ के नियम एवं व्हीटस्टोन सेतु

topics.name: Practical Physics: Meter Bridge and Potentiometer Principles
topics.nameHi: प्रायोगिक भौतिकी: मीटर सेतु

nmcNotes: Meter Bridge and finding resistance of a wire are key practical physics topics. Potentiometer was removed from NCERT theory but basic null-point comparison concepts may appear under practical syllabus.
keyConcepts: Current I = n e A v_d; Current density J = σ E = n e v_d.
Drift velocity v_d = e E τ / m; Mobility μ = v_d / E = e τ / m.
Kirchhoff's Junction Rule is based on Conservation of Charge; Loop Rule is based on Conservation of Energy.
Wheatstone bridge balanced condition: R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ → no current flows through galvanometer.
formulaHints: R = ρ l / A; ρ = m / (n e² τ)
R_t = R₀ (1 + α ΔT)
Cells in parallel: E_eq = (E₁/r₁ + E₂/r₂) / (1/r₁ + 1/r₂), r_eq = r₁r₂ / (r₁ + r₂)
Maximum power transfer theorem: P is max when load resistance R = internal resistance r, P_max = E² / (4r)
commonMistakes: Confusing terminal potential difference V with emf E. When discharging: V = E - Ir; when charging: V = E + Ir.
Applying Kirchhoff loop rule without being consistent with sign convention for emf and resistor IR drops.
shortTricks: Symmetry method for cube/ladder resistor networks: across body diagonal R_eq = (5/6)R; across face diagonal R_eq = (3/4)R; across edge R_eq = (7/12)R.
If length of wire is stretched by x% (where x < 5%), resistance increases by approximately 2x%.

topics.name: Magnetic Dipole, Earth's Magnetism & Magnetic Materials (Dia, Para, Ferro)
topics.nameHi: चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव, भू-चुंबकत्व एवं चुंबकीय पदार्थ

nmcNotes: Cyclotron is deleted. Conversion of galvanometer to ammeter (shunt S) and voltmeter (series R) is a designated practical syllabus point.
keyConcepts: Lorentz Force F = q(E + v × B). When v ⊥ B, path is circle: radius r = mv / (qB) = p / (qB) = √(2mK) / (qB).
Time period in uniform B: T = 2πm / (qB) is completely INDEPENDENT of speed and radius.
Conversion to Ammeter: S = [I_g / (I - I_g)] · G in parallel.
Conversion to Voltmeter: R = (V / I_g) - G in series.
formulaHints: Straight wire: B = μ₀ I / (2π d)
Center of circular coil: B = μ₀ N I / (2R); On axis: B = μ₀ N I R² / [2(R² + x²)^(3/2)]
Force between parallel wires: F/L = μ₀ I₁ I₂ / (2π d) (attract if parallel, repel if antiparallel)
Curie's Law: χ ∝ 1/T for paramagnetic materials
commonMistakes: Magnetic force F = q(v × B) does NO WORK on charged particle because force is always perpendicular to velocity. Kinetic energy remains constant.
Connecting shunt resistor in series instead of parallel when making ammeter.
shortTricks: For helical motion: pitch p = v_parallel · T = (v cosθ) · (2πm / qB).
Diamagnetic susceptibility is small and negative (independent of temperature); Superconductors show perfect diamagnetism (χ = -1, Meissner effect).

topics.name: Power in AC Circuit, Power Factor, Wattless Current & Transformers
topics.nameHi: प्रत्यावर्ती परिपथ में शक्ति, शक्ति गुणांक, ट्रांसफार्मर

keyConcepts: Lenz's law: Induced current always opposes the cause that produces it (direction given by conservation of energy).
Series LCR Resonance: X_L = X_C → ω₀ = 1 / √(LC). At resonance, impedance Z = R (minimum), current is maximum.
Power in AC: P_avg = V_rms I_rms cosφ; Power factor cosφ = R / Z.
For pure inductor or capacitor, φ = 90° → cosφ = 0 → P_avg = 0 (Wattless current).
formulaHints: Induced emf e = -N (dΦ/dt); Self-induced emf e = -L (dI/dt)
Energy in inductor U = 0.5 L I²
Impedance Z = √[R² + (X_L - X_C)²], where X_L = ωL, X_C = 1 / (ωC)
Quality Factor Q = (1/R) √(L/C) = ω₀ / Δω
Transformer: V_s / V_p = N_s / N_p = I_p / I_s
commonMistakes: Using peak values instead of RMS values in AC power calculation (V_rms = V₀ / √2, I_rms = I₀ / √2).
Assuming DC formulas apply to AC inductive circuits without accounting for reactive impedance.
shortTricks: Remember CIVIL: in Capacitor (C), Current (I) leads Voltage (V); in Inductor (L), Voltage (V) leads Current (I).
In series LCR at resonance, voltage across inductor and capacitor are equal and 180° out of phase, so V_LC = 0.

topics.nameHi: तरंगाग्र, हाइगेंस सिद्धांत, यंग का द्वि-स्लिट प्रयोग (YDSE)

topics.name: Diffraction at Single Slit & Central Maximum Width
topics.nameHi: एकल स्लिट विवर्तन

nmcNotes: Resolving power of microscope/telescope and Polarisation were trimmed/deleted in NMC syllabus. YDSE fringe width and Lens Maker's formula are ultra high yield.
keyConcepts: Lens Maker's Formula: 1/f = (μ - 1) [1/R₁ - 1/R₂].
Total Internal Reflection condition: light travels from denser to rarer medium and angle of incidence i > critical angle C (sin C = 1/μ).
YDSE fringe width β = λ D / d. Position of nth bright fringe y_n = n λ D / d; nth dark fringe y_n = (2n - 1) λ D / (2d).
Single slit diffraction: Central maximum width = 2 λ D / a (twice the width of secondary maxima).
formulaHints: Prism: μ = sin[(A + δ_m)/2] / sin(A/2); For thin prism: δ = (μ - 1)A
Combination of lenses in contact: 1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂; Power P = P₁ + P₂
Astronomical Telescope: Magnification m = -f_o / f_e (normal adjustment); Length L = f_o + f_e
Compound Microscope: m = -(L / f_o) · (D / f_e)
commonMistakes: Mixing up sign conventions for focal length (Convex lens f > 0, Concave lens f < 0; Convex mirror f > 0, Concave mirror f < 0).
Confusing condition for minima in diffraction (a sinθ = nλ) with maxima in YDSE (d sinθ = nλ).
shortTricks: When YDSE apparatus is immersed in liquid of refractive index μ, fringe width decreases: β' = β / μ.
If a convex lens of index μ_g is placed in liquid of index μ_l: if μ_l > μ_g, lens changes its nature (convex behaves as concave).

topics.name: Mass Defect, Binding Energy per Nucleon & Nuclear Fission/Fusion
topics.nameHi: द्रव्यमान क्षति, प्रति न्यूक्लियॉन बंधन ऊर्जा

nmcNotes: Davisson-Germer experiment and Radioactivity (alpha, beta, gamma decay law) were deleted in NMC revised syllabus.
keyConcepts: Einstein's Photoelectric equation: K_max = hν - Φ = e V_0.
Stopping potential V_0 depends ONLY on frequency of light and work function, NOT on light intensity.
Photoelectric current is directly proportional to intensity of incident radiation.
de Broglie wavelength: λ = h / p = h / √(2mK) = 12.27 / √V Å for electron accelerated through V volts.
Bohr radii r_n = 0.529 (n² / Z) Å; Energy E_n = -13.6 (Z² / n²) eV.
formulaHints: Rydberg formula: 1/λ = R Z² (1/n₁² - 1/n₂²)
Spectral Series: Lyman (n₁=1, UV), Balmer (n₁=2, Visible), Paschen (n₁=3, IR), Brackett (n₁=4, IR), Pfund (n₁=5, IR)
Nuclear radius: R = R₀ A^(1/3) (where R₀ ≈ 1.2 × 10⁻¹⁵ m); Nuclear density is constant (~2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³)
commonMistakes: Thinking increasing light intensity increases the kinetic energy of emitted photoelectrons (intensity only increases photon count and photocurrent).
Confusing shortest wavelength (series limit, n₂=∞) with longest wavelength (first line, n₂=n₁+1).
shortTricks: Ratio of shortest wavelength to longest wavelength in Lyman series = 3/4; in Balmer series = 5/9.
For electron accelerated through V: λ = 1.227 / √V nm.

topics.name: Logic Gates: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR & Truth Tables
topics.nameHi: तर्क द्वार (Logic Gates): सत्यता सारणी

nmcNotes: Transistors (BJT) and Zener diode as voltage regulator were deleted from theory in NCERT/NMC, but Logic Gates and p-n junction diodes are consistently asked every single year.
keyConcepts: Intrinsic: n_e = n_h = n_i. Law of mass action: n_e · n_h = n_i².
In p-type (Group 13 dopant: B, Al, In, Ga): n_h >> n_e; in n-type (Group 15 dopant: P, As, Sb): n_e >> n_h.
In forward bias, depletion layer width decreases and barrier potential decreases; in reverse bias, width increases.
Photodiode is ALWAYS operated in reverse bias because fractional change in minority carrier current is much easier to measure.
NAND and NOR are universal gates (any Boolean function can be constructed using only NAND or only NOR).
formulaHints: Half wave rectifier frequency = f_in; Full wave rectifier output frequency = 2 f_in
De Morgan's Laws: (A + B)' = A' · B'; (A · B)' = A' + B'
commonMistakes: Assuming doped semiconductor carries net electric charge. Semiconductors are ALWAYS electrically neutral overall!
Confusing forward bias connection: Forward bias requires p-side connected to positive terminal (higher potential) and n-side to negative terminal.
shortTricks: NAND gate with inputs joined together acts as NOT gate. NOR gate with inputs joined together acts as NOT gate.
Solar cell does not require external bias; it generates voltage by photovoltaic effect (worked in 4th quadrant of V-I graph).
